sources.title: README.md · Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.2-3B at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The results demonstrate that Nanbeige4.2-3B delivers strong performance well beyond its parameter scale. With only 3B non-embedding parameters, it consistently outperforms larger models, including Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B, across general-agent, code-agent, and reasoning benchmarks, while remaining competitive on alignment tasks.
